notes: Warm and low in glare, for reading for longer. Light is paper rather than white: a warm off-white background (L 0.94, hue 80) and a darker card, with dark brown ink rather than black (L 0.27), so the contrast is well over AA without the glare of black on white. Dark is a warm near-black with dimmed cream text (L 0.86) rather than white. The accent is a rust (hue 45) in light and an amber (hue 70) in dark. The key-word colours are a blue, a green and a plum, muted to suit the paper, and found by trial against the build's checks: the level's text contrast on the background and the card, and at least 0.12 apart from each other and from the ink in OKLab. The palette makes no colour-vision promise. Written for the framework, 2026-10-28.
